snippet.title: Ultimate Theater Simulator: Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play ULTIMATE THEATER SIMULATOR October 29th https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541370/Ultimate_Theater_Simulator

Demo is out now for free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3810460/Ultimate_Theater_Simulator_Demo/
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ultimate Theater Simulator is a first-person cinema management game where you screen movies, serve snacks, hire staff, handle chaos, and grow your dream theater from the ground up.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
